title: Select's Monthly Share - TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Schedule Note
content:
**Schedule note.** For a TRICARE Prime catch-up installment, Select's monthly share is read from the beneficiary's TRICARE Select installment charge whose coverage period begins latest, according to that installment's frequency.

| Latest TRICARE Select installment | Select's monthly share |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | its whole amount |
| a quarterly installment | one third of its amount, rounded to the cent |
| otherwise (an annual installment) | one twelfth of its amount (its amount divided by 12), rounded to the cent |

## Hypothetical installments

| Latest TRICARE Select installment | Monthly share |
|---|---|
| monthly, 25.00 | 25.00 |
| quarterly, 80.00 | 26.67 |
| annual, 300.00 | 25.00 |

Only the installment whose coverage period begins latest is read; earlier TRICARE Select installments do not enter the share.
